evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep proceeded directly into logistics probing about storage unit type and dimensions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns elicited because two-concerns question was never asked.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep gave a single estimate time window (Tuesday 27 October, 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM) with no mention of value days or date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep closed with 'Thank you so much and have a great day' with no ask for the business, rate lock statement, or booking confirmation of willingness.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently, including property type, room count, walking distances, access concerns, and fragile items, building toward an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire sales framework — no two-concerns question, no promises, no pricing framing, no genuine close. Relearn the v4 card steps in order: Step 2 opens by asking about movers' timeliness and item damage; Step 3 delivers the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage before probing; Step 7 ends with an explicit ask and rate-lock statement before saying goodbye.
